The second edition of the **INDEMIC Seminar Series** featured **Dhihram Tenrisau**, a student in the MSc Health Data Science programme at the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (LSHTM).

Dhihram presented his work on **"Phylodynamic investigation of norovirus outbreaks in the UK 2003–2023"**, exploring how phylodynamic methods can reconstruct the evolutionary and epidemiological history of norovirus — a highly transmissible pathogen responsible for recurrent outbreaks in healthcare settings and the wider community.
